pretreatments.description: Mechanical grinding of corn stover to pass through a 5 mm sieve

Solid-state alkaline pretreatment using NaOH solution at concentrations of 0.25, 0.625, 1.25, and 1.85 M (corresponding to loadings of 1.0%, 2.5%, 5.0% and 7.5% w/w), kept at ambient temperature (20 ± 0.5 °C) in sealed zipper plastic bags for 24 h
Simultaneous alkali treatment and digestion (SATD) using NaOH solution at concentrations of 0.25, 0.625, and 1.25 M mixed with effluent and immediately fed into the anaerobic digestion reactor
